environmentNote: Other compilation/regression work ran concurrently. These are functional observations; host wall time, MIPS and speed figures are omitted and no performance conclusion is drawn. Requested windows may be slightly overshot by worker batching; actual guest time/instructions are retained.
byteSource: Unchanged catalog defaults with investigator-local copies of official segments. The actual platform loader checked every pinned SHA256. This does not establish browser CORS or live remote availability.
sourceCheckpoint: The executable hash identifies this unpublished integration checkpoint. Later isolated Watcher input changes must not be mistaken for this exact binary.

retention.rawReceipts: Excluded because storage sessions and application logs contain device identifiers. Original file SHA256 values are retained.
retention.rawSerial: Excluded; exact byte counts and SHA256 plus selected identifier-free stage markers retained.
retention.frames: No capture returned a frame in any of the 19 observations; NO_FRAME is preserved rather than replaced with a diagnostic image.

conclusion: All 17 original factory images reached ROM boot, app startup and e-paper initialization. Initial six-second windows all stopped in genuine SD retry work. The EE04 and EE05 7.5-inch 15-second representatives progressed to Wi-Fi initialization, reporting 63% and 0% battery respectively, still without a completed frame. This is boot-stage evidence, not factory UI compatibility certification.
